scope: Read-only portability review of seven-file candidate; no guest execution and no changes to overlay or frozen source
checks: Default browser path correctly resolves Tools/Symbian/browser from tests/screenplay-update
Compiles production implementation directly using subprocess argument arrays; no download or fixed workspace path
Original eight-case 75-assertion harness retained apart from complete Event initialization and copyright
TSurfaceId class tag matches production forward declaration; fixed-width scalar aliases and uintptr_t pointer slots support common ILP32/LP64 hosts
Official KAllScreens value 0x00ffffff, explicit initializer_list include, and strict compiler warnings are present
README accurately limits host fakes and states Close cancellation precondition; no display or performance claims
32-bit host execution was not independently performed

findings.description: UBSan defaults to recoverable reporting for some errors; stderr can contain a finding while executable exits zero and report remains pass.
findings.recommendation: Add -fno-sanitize-recover=all to --sanitize flags, or configure equivalent UBSan fail-fast behavior.

findings.description: --cxx is parsed as a shell-style command by shlex.split. A compiler executable path containing spaces must itself be quoted inside the argument.
findings.recommendation: Optionally document this command quoting requirement; source/build/output path arguments are already passed safely.
findings.resolution: Resolved: README now documents compiler command quoting and source/build/output paths.
